verdict.rationale: The only bulk-style behavior in the evidence is cascading deletes. Deleting a User removes all of its Threads and thread artifacts in a single API call, and deleting a node also deletes all connected edges. `thread.add_messages` accepts multiple messages per call, and zepctl mentions "data operations" without detail. Missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk ingestion API, bulk update or delete across arbitrary item sets, detail on zepctl bulk commands, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
